Chapter 1: Harbour Morning

Maren reached the quay before sunrise. The air smelled of salt and the gulls were already circling over the harbour wall. She put out her lantern and stood at the edge, watching the water.

Tobias came along the quay with an armful of nets. "The waves are restless today," he said.

Maren nodded.

Old Harl sat beside his boat and watched them both. "When the water looks this calm," he said quietly, "that is when you should be most afraid. A storm always comes on soft feet."

Then the bell in the tower rang three times and the whole quay fell silent.
